data.heading: Birds
Flightless birds
data.text: Birds have feathers and wings that help them fly.
Birds have scales on their legs.
Birds have beaks but no teeth.
Birds have a bone inside their body called furcula. This bone is also known as wishbone.
The wishbone protects the bird's chest from the force of the wings when it flies.
The hummingbird is the smallest bird in the world.
